query: INSERT INTO whatsapp_participant_receipt(account_id,binding_id,source_id,participant_jid,receipt_state,source_at) SELECT $1,b.id,$4,$5,$6,$7 FROM whatsapp_group_binding b JOIN whatsapp_group_membership m ON m.binding_id=b.id JOIN whatsapp_linked_account a ON a.id=m.account_id WHERE b.group_jid=$2 AND m.account_id=$1 AND m.authorization_generation=$3 AND m.consent_ended_at IS NULL AND whatsapp_linked_can_view(b.channel_id,a.user_id) ON CONFLICT(account_id,binding_id,source_id,participant_jid,receipt_state) DO UPDATE SET source_at=GREATEST(whatsapp_participant_receipt.source_at,excluded.source_at)
